Fix the source so that the suite passes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
- Do not add new dependencies; the standard library is all that is available.
- Keep the public API of the `solution` package unchanged: `toposort, CycleError`.
summary: The visible suite now passes (3/3). The bug was in `solution/util.py`, in `_find_cycle`. When the DFS hit a back edge, it returned `stack[i + 1:]`, which dropped the node the back edge points to. For a self-loop like `a -> a` that produced an empty list, which is falsy, so the search returned nothing and `CycleError` was raised with `cycle = None`. For the two-node and larger-graph cases, the reported cycle was missing its first node, so the closing edge check failed. I changed that slice to `stack[i:]` so the cycle includes its start node. That is the only file I changed. I spot-checked self-loop, two-node, and downstream-of-cycle inputs, and they now report closed cycles. I did not touch anything under `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `toposort` / `CycleError` API.
